NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Gentle Walk reads your step count to show your everyday activity in Progress.
NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Gentle Walk saves your walks and exercise sessions to Apple Health.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Gentle Walk uses your location only during outdoor walks to measure distance and draw your route. It stays on this phone.
NSMotionUsageDescription: Gentle Walk uses motion to count your sit-to-stands while your phone is held to your chest, and to measure outdoor walks without location.
